verifications.claim: The 98th Academy Awards are on March 15, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "The 98th Academy Awards ceremony will take place at 7 p.m. ET on March 15" (R1); "The 98th Academy Awards, also known as the Oscars, are being held on Sunday, March 15" (R2); "98th Academy Awards" on Sunday night (R3); March 15, 2026 (R4); "The 98th Academy Awards will be held this Sunday, March 15, 2026" (R6); "The 98th Academy Awards take place Sunday, March 15" (R7)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly confirm the date and edition number.

verifications.claim: The 98th Academy Awards air live at 7 p.m. ET/4 p.m. PT on ABC.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "at 7 p.m. ET on March 15" (R1); "tune into ABC at 7 p.m. ET/4 p.m. PT" (R3); "The Oscars will begin at 7 p.m. ET/4 p.m. PT" on ABC (R6)
verifications.reasoning: Sources directly state the exact time and channel.

verifications.claim: The 98th Academy Awards stream simultaneously on Hulu.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "it will simultaneously stream live on Hulu in the US" (R3); "stream live on Hulu" (R6)
verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly mention simultaneous live streaming on Hulu.

verifications.claim: Official red carpet coverage begins at 3:30 p.m. ET/12:30 p.m. PT.

verifications.evidence: "ABC’s official red carpet segment is kicking off at 6:30 p.m. EST" (R2); "Official ABC red carpet coverage will start at 3:30 p.m. ET / 12:30 p.m. PT" (R6)
verifications.reasoning: R6 supports exact time, but R2 contradicts with 6:30 p.m. EST for ABC official red carpet.
